intro_voiceover: Welcome to our countdown of the 20 greatest thriller movies of all time. Stay till the end — you won't want to miss number one.
outro_voiceover: That's our top 20 thriller movies of all time. Which one is your favourite? Let us know in the comments, and don't forget to like and subscribe for more.

movies.title: Prisoners
movies.voiceover_text: Coming in at number 20, Prisoners from 2013. Directed by Denis Villeneuve, this gripping thriller follows two families whose daughters disappear on Thanksgiving Day. Hugh Jackman delivers a raw, powerful performance as a desperate father who takes the law into his own hands. Jake Gyllenhaal plays the detective on the case. With its relentless tension and moral complexity, Prisoners asks how far a parent would go to save their child.

movies.title: Shutter Island
movies.voiceover_text: Number 19 is Shutter Island, Martin Scorsese's psychological thriller from 2010. Leonardo DiCaprio plays U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels, sent to investigate a missing patient from a remote psychiatric facility. As the mystery deepens, the line between reality and delusion begins to blur. Few films match its atmospheric dread and the shocking revelation that reframes everything you've just watched.

movies.title: Inception
movies.voiceover_text: At number 18, Christopher Nolan's Inception from 2010 remains one of cinema's most ambitious achievements. A thief who enters people's dreams to steal secrets is tasked with the opposite — planting an idea in a target's mind. With Leonardo DiCaprio leading an incredible ensemble, and Hans Zimmer's iconic score, Inception dazzles the mind while keeping the heart engaged.
